answer: Prayers & Duties >> Salah (Prayer) Question ID: 162117 Country: Bangladesh Title: Is there any prohibition for qaza namaz between sunnat and fardh namaz in Fajr or is it sinful? Question: Is there any prohibition for qaza namaz between sunnat and fardh namaz in Fajr or is it sinful? Answer ID: 162117 Posted on: Sep 1, 2020 Bismillah hir-Rahman nir-Rahim ! (Fatwa: 1165/993/SD=9/1439) It is not forbidden to offer qaza salah between the sunnah and fardh salah of Fajr rather it is lawful. Allah (Subhana Wa Ta'ala) knows Best Darul Ifta, Darul Uloom Deoband, India
